raw_comment: From this graph, I noticed that the northwest has an exceptional amount of drought, which makes me wonder what caused this change. In past years, I have studied that the majority of drought was centered in California, making me wonder about the impacts of global warming in recent years. I also wonder about the cause of the abnormally dry conditions in New York, considering that the area typically receives a reasonable amount of rainfall. This graph relates to my community and me because it should prompt us to be aware of the atmospheric conditions, such as those pertaining to global warming, that are causing the dry conditions in New York. New York usually is never a dry area, therefore my community and I should begin to consider our actions that may be contributing to these dry conditions.
